declaration.negotiation_history_statement: Ostrander Bell LLP negotiated the settlement with Brightline’s counsel on behalf of the proposed class. The parties agreed to a $30 million class fund, automatically distributed to identifiable members without a claims process, and a separate $2.5 million request for attorneys’ fees and expenses, subject to court approval. The fee terms were discussed alongside class relief, not only after class relief was agreed. Brightline has not agreed to refrain from opposing the fee request, and any fees the Court does not award will benefit the class rather than revert to Brightline. Counsel receives fixed compensation independent of the settlement or fee award; any approved fee is paid to the funding foundation. This statement describes the process and resulting terms without disclosing confidential mediation communications.
